posts.caption:
Mofongo is the dish that makes everyone stop talking and reach for seconds. Green plantains, fried, pounded with garlic and chicharrón. The recipe is on the blog — link in bio. 🇵🇷

#mofongo #puertoricanrecipes #boricuafood #mofongorecipe #latinfood #puertorico

Pernil is the reason the oven runs all day on Nochebuena. Crispy skin, garlicky mojo, fall-apart pork. Master it once, make it forever. Recipe on the blog.

#pernil #pernilrecipe #nochebuena #puertoricanfood #boricuafood #caribbeanfood

Arroz con gandules — the dish that anchors every boricua table. Golden rice, sofrito, and pigeon peas in one pot. Full recipe on the blog.

#arrozcongandules #puertoricanrecipes #latinfood #arroz #boricuafood #sundaydinner

Coquito season is a state of mind. Creamy coconut, cinnamon, a little rum — the holiday drink that starts in November and never stops. Recipe up now.

#coquito #coquitorecipe #navidad #puertoricanfood #christmasdrinks #holidayseason

Arroz con pollo is the weeknight hero of Puerto Rican cooking. One pot, chicken and rice, deeply seasoned. Comfort food that never misses. On the blog.

#arrozconpollo #puertoricanrecipes #onepotmeal #comfortfood #latinfood #boricuafood

Tostones: twice-fried, garlicky, impossible to eat just one. The side that makes every plate complete. Recipe on the blog — link in bio.

#tostones #plantains #puertoricanfood #boricuafood #caribbeanfood #sidedish

Pastelillos — flaky fried turnovers stuffed with seasoned beef. Beach day favorite, party essential. Full recipe on the blog.

#pastelillos #empanadas #puertoricanrecipes #frituras #boricuafood #latinfood
The dish that stops the whole table: mofongo. Green plantains, garlic, chicharrón — pounded until dense and irresistible. Full recipe on the blog (EN + ES). Buen provecho, familia.
Planning Nochebuena? Start here: pernil with crispy skin and garlicky mojo. We broke down the exact timeline so the table comes together without the panic. Blog link in the comments.
Arroz con gandules is the rice every Puerto Rican table anchors on. Our recipe keeps it true to the classic with easy mainland swaps. Check the blog.
It's coquito season somewhere. Our family recipe — coconut, cinnamon, a touch of rum. Make a batch, gift a bottle. Recipe on the blog.
Arroz con pollo, the one-pot that feeds the whole house. Deep sofrito flavor, tender chicken, golden rice. On the blog — bilingual.
Tostones tonight? Twice-fried plantains, a little garlic, a lot of love. Recipe on the blog with the mojo to match.
Weekend fritura alert: pastelillos. Crispy dough, seasoned beef, zero leftovers. Full recipe on the blog.
